desc: The honesty layer: every condition not fully compiled into the expression language, classified. judgment-input = RONR is judgment-shaped here by its own account; the condition enters via the adjudication machine or a recorded world-fact, and that is the CORRECT model, not a defect. schema-gap = the model's schema/grammar does not yet carry what a full compilation needs; stage 5 (or a later stage-4 pass) should close it. annotation-grade = normative content preserved as cited annotation on structured data, consumed by a human/LLM reader or a later compilation pass, not yet by the evaluator.

judgment_inputs.status: correct-by-design: the judgment content arrives as an input event; the routing around it is fully compiled
world-facts the assembly knows and the engine cannot derive; supplied with events

schema_gaps.where: rules.json resolution; guards act-in-order-under-governing-rules, rule-suspendible, continuing-breach; the suspend-rules applicability row's rule binding
schema_gaps.gap: which rules cover which acts, and which unsuspendable category covers which rule, is content classification. The closed category lists are data; the per-rule classification is a recorded field on rule records (content-not-name [2:24]) that adopted-rule ingestion must supply. The guards' quantifications assume derived queries (governing_rules_forbidding, unsuspendable_matches, breach_grounds_matching) whose classification inputs are those fields.
schema_gaps.severity: the largest genuine gap; rules-resolution is only as formal as the rule records fed to it

schema_gaps.where: schema.json clock; take-from-table applicability; notice thresholds
schema_gaps.gap: meetings and sessions are ids, not records: no kind (regular / special / adjourned / annual), no call/notice reference, no formation rule. Blocks compiling: take-from-table's special-meeting restriction (only if tabled this session or the call names the question/subject [34:3]) and its class-of-business/heading gate [34:2(1), 17:6] (current-heading state — the last heading-reached event — deserves a first-class clock field); special-meeting scope limits [9:15]; notice+X threshold verification scopes; serial-mass-meeting session identity (each meeting a session iff meetings are on fixed periodic rule; whole series one session if set-each-time or at-the-call-of-the-chair [53:32]). Minimal fix: Meeting {id, kind, session_ref, call_ref?} plus clock.current_heading; the call artifact itself is phase 5.
schema_gaps.severity: medium-high; first thing phase 5's artifact layer needs slots for

schema_gaps.where: schema.json; lifecycle committed state; council.json subordinate_to
schema_gaps.gap: committees have no records: 'committed' does not say to WHICH committee; subordinate_to is an untyped reference; discharge/instruct/partial-report and the phase-5 recursion need Committee {id, kind, roll, charter_ref, parent} and a committee_ref on the committed question.

schema_gaps.where: actions.json (raise-point-of-order, appeal, object-to-unanimous-consent, give-previous-notice, respond-to-inquiry, read-paper, declare-recess-or-adjournment, stand-at-ease pair); precedence.json CFOTD timeliness disjunct
schema_gaps.gap: all event NAMES are declared in vocabulary.json (sweep-enforced), but several ["event-occurred", ...] SCOPE tokens (second argument) remain informal ('just-now', 'pending-consent', 'since-ruling', 'departing-motion-undisposed', 'inquiry-pending', 'open-now'). Each is implementable as a history query, but the scope algebra (windows between events) deserves first-class schema treatment: a Window type {opened_by, closed_by} generalizing the timer expires_on_event pattern.
schema_gaps.severity: mechanical; no rule content is missing, only query formalization

schema_gaps.gap: no closure argument exists that the action table is complete against the book. Known-thin: minutes approval/correction as actions; the chair's opening call-to-order sequence [3:15]; nomination-method and polls mechanics beyond the nominate entry; disciplinary actions [61-63] beyond put-ignored-question. Audit history: nominate, demand-separate-vote, declare-quorum-absent, put-ignored-question, stand-at-ease, and the chair's conditional vote were each found wholly missing — the category, not just the instances, is the risk.
schema_gaps.severity: medium; the table is the surface where the-list-is-the-obligation does the most work

schema_gaps.where: registry.json vote_exceptions / vote_notes / reconsider conditional objects / notes fields
schema_gaps.gap: threshold-exception selectors (e.g. main-motion's suspends-a-rule -> two-thirds [10:8(7)]; committee reconsider two-thirds-with-drop [37:35(3)]) and reconsiderability windows (until-progress, before-execution, unexecuted-part, never-after-postponement-return [16:15]) are typed-prose annotation, not yet compiled selectors. The window vocabulary is closed and small; a later pass should enum-ify: reconsider windows {always, until-target-taken-up, until-progress, before-any-vote-under-order, unexecuted-part, once-person-notified, never-after-partial-execution} and threshold selectors as expr alternatives.
schema_gaps.severity: medium; these fire at threshold-selection and R2 evaluation time

schema_gaps.gap: the main-motion row now carries the same-question bar with its renewable-after-progress relief [38:7], but the same-session non-renewal principle for SECONDARY motions (a rejected commit/postpone/LED/PQ/table cannot be re-moved on the same question until progress [38:1-9]) has no compiled bar on those rows — currently annotation-grade in the rule cluster. Needs an event-history conjunct per row: same motion rejected on this question this session, and not renewable-after-progress.

elections are a boolean plus ballot-counting rules: no Office/seat-count records, no candidate/nomination objects, no ballot-round history (repeated balloting with no forced dropouts [46:32-33] is round-indexed state), and election finality [46:46] (final on declaration if present-not-declining / on notification if absent-without-consent; declination reopens with immediate revote) has its event (notified-of-election) but no compiled finality expression closing the reconsider window.
schema_gaps.severity: medium; phase-5/6 will need the objects

schema_gaps.gap: per-event member-presence history is not recorded, so presence-at-adoption refinements (unanimous-consent prevailing side = those present at THAT moment; irrelevant-negative adoptions [44:9(a)]) approximate with current presence or route to assertion.

small-board (49:21), committee (50:25), and committee-of-the-whole (52:9, whitelist) overlays are compiled. Remaining note-grade: full committee procedure ([50-51] beyond the compiled deltas), quasi-committee and informal consideration [52:22-32], and the floor_formality/chair-need-not-rise items (rendering-level, param-carried). The mass-meeting/convention/legislative/public-body configurations are deliberately partial sketches marking the axes with verified cites.
schema_gaps.severity: bounded; three compiled proof configurations demonstrate the mechanism

schema_gaps.gap: negative_called, ballots_collected, and polls_closed now phase the Vote record (the adjourn-during-ballot window [21:6(1)] is compiled), but method mechanics (roll-call order, ballot distribution/collection sequence, already-voted tracking) remain stage-5 orchestration.

resolution part-structure (preamble, paragraphs under seriatim) is below frame granularity, so 16:8 (an undebated preamble is exempt from a previous-question order until separately ordered) and per-paragraph seriatim state are unmodeled.

annotation_grade.content: germaneness rules [12:16-21], filling-blank ordering [12:107-111], renewal rule-cluster details [38:1-9], not_applicable lists for reconsider/rescind [37:9(2), 35:6] — the last two are consumed as the recorded reconsider_excluded / unrescindable inputs

annotation_grade.where: engine.json serialization on_report / protocol.json requests, decorum, voting_exchange prose fields
annotation_grade.content: procedural sequencing detail preserved with citations; the actions and events it constrains are in the compiled layer, the fine sequencing is stage-5 orchestration
compiled at the guard level; the two-thirds set-aside sub-votes are ordinary motions through the normal action path

the 15:8 subsequent-coverage rule and 15:16 deadline-vs-budget closure semantics are typed enums with cites; the evaluator consequences (which counters an order reaches; how interruption time charges) are stage-5 orchestration reading these fields
